    In a supporting host, H.I.M. can ask that conversation to explain your selected result. No second agent is invented.

    Correct this task

    In a connected host, stage your correction locally, then send it to this conversation. Review the staged payload below: your correction, observed question, up to 2,000 characters of the returned answer, status, source and task identifiers. No private MEOK graph is updated by this panel.

    Observe a task in a connected host to stage a correction.

    Review exactly what will be sent
    Stage a correction to review the question, result excerpt and text.

    Sources for this task

    Tool-returned labels are shown as reported. This panel does not re-sign or silently rescore them.

      Host-delivered record
      No tool result received from a host.

      Public board context

      No board record loaded. This is reference context, not a score for your conversation.

      Bring your benchmark results

      Inspect and lm-evaluation-harness summaries can sit beside GSPC evidence. Original metric names, values, model labels and task versions stay visible.

      Local import only. Nothing is uploaded or executed. Imported results are unverified; unrelated metrics are not averaged.

      Choose a test that answers your question

      Task accuracy, robustness, privacy and tool-control evidence are different questions. An offline benchmark is not a live safety score.

      • Inspect — evaluation runs and agent traces.
      • lm-evaluation-harness — versioned model/task evaluations.
      • HELM — additional evaluation context; no importer claimed here.

      Running external evaluations needs its own dataset rights, sandbox, model access and budget. Opening this panel launches none.

      Learn at the decision point

      0 practice checks

      Short practice linked to the existing Council Academy. Learning helps you inspect a decision; it does not grant an agent permission to act.

      Pinned Academy source, selected 4 November 2026. Not refreshed this session.

      These are practice checks, not formal exercise completion. The existing Academy requires reproduced evidence and a negative control that fails. No certificate, accreditation, human identity or XP entitlement is issued.

      Review before notifying anyone

      Exports task status and tool labels only. A human must add the reproduction, check permissions and choose Council, the vendor or WG-SAFE as a recipient. This button sends nothing and authorizes no repair.

      Official learning, alongside your workspace

      External courses remain with their providers. No private academy database or third-party course completion is connected here.

      • Council Academy — existing tracks and reproduction rules.
      • OpenAI Academy — provider-maintained learning.
      • WG-SAFE — upstream work and contribution process.

      Framework references and indexed provisions are not automatically implemented controls. Source freshness, jurisdiction, applicability and human review remain separate.

      Your connected workspace

      • Current host

        Standalone browser. Native host connection not established.

      • Council public tools

        Available through the fixed evidence route when you send a task. Availability is established by each response.

      • MEOK agent coordination

        The panel does not yet attach private agent credentials or issue Hive jobs. A listed provider is not a connected worker.

      • Personal PAL and voice

        Use the host conversation to discuss a selected result. No microphone, camera, model endpoint or identity is enabled by this panel.

      A second screen, without another controller

      In standalone mode, open a read-only window and move it to an extended display or TV. It shows task status and tool names only—not questions, answers or imported files.

      Same-browser, same-origin display only. This is not smart-TV pairing, a Cast receiver or permission to control another device.

      Measurement and observation—not certification. Imported evidence, AI explanations, human approval and observed effects are separate. No monitoring continues after this view is closed.
